title: QUIC RFC 9000 Maximum UDP Payload Size Receiver Limit Verification
verification_method: Focused S18P2-0007 requirement-home tests over endpoint receive-limit dispatch behavior and local transport-parameter effect publication, plus Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers routed UDP datagrams being processed only when their payload length is less than or equal to the connection's local max_udp_payload_size and being dropped before PacketReceived posting when larger.
expected_result: The focused tests show exact-limit datagrams route to the runtime, larger datagrams return Dropped without a runtime transition, the absent-parameter default limit is enforced, and local transport-parameter commit publishes the endpoint effect carrying max_udp_payload_size.
procedure: Run the focused S18P2-0007 and endpoint-routing regression requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The datagram is attributable to a registered connection route before the receive-size limit is evaluated.
The connection's local transport parameters have either published max_udp_payload_size or rely on the RFC 9000 default value.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim UDP socket receive-buffer sizing, path MTU discovery, peer send-size enforcement, broader Section 18.2 closure, public configuration APIs, or hosted interop readiness.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-06. The Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, the focused S18P2-0007 and endpoint-routing regression filter passed 13/13, regenerated coverage triage marks REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S18P2-0007 trace_clean and reports 1,260 of 1,771 QUIC requirements trace-clean overall, core SpecTrace JSON validation passed for 442 artifacts, the full Release no-build suite passed 4,460/4,460, and git diff --check returned exit code 0 with line-ending warnings only.
